name: @hyperpolymath/boj-server
description: Bundle of Joy (BoJ) MCP Server — cartridge-based DevOps + multi-agent coordination toolkit with 125 domain cartridges (database, container, git, k8s, observability, secrets, IaC, multi-instance AI coord, and more). Formally verified (Idris2) core; MPL-2.0.
author: Jonathan D.A. Jewell <j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk>

scripts.start: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bun mcp-bridge/main.js; elif command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec deno run --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read mcp-bridge/main.js; else exec node mcp-bridge/main.js; fi
scripts.test: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test mcp-bridge/tests/dispatch_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/routing_args_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/declared_args_test.js; elif command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1; then deno test --allow-read --allow-env --allow-run --allow-net mcp-bridge/tests/dispatch_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/routing_args_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/declared_args_test.js; else node --test mcp-bridge/tests/dispatch_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/routing_args_test.js mcp-bridge/tests/declared_args_test.js; fi
